screens.prompt:
High-fidelity UI design mockup of a touch-screen POS (point-of-sale) web app used at the counter of a Korean ski rental shop; the app is called 스키노트. One single screen shown flat and straight-on, filling the whole canvas edge to edge: no monitor bezel, no browser chrome, no hands, no perspective, no drop shadow around the screen. Design frame 1024×600 px (a small, low-resolution POS monitor), so everything is large, NOTHING is cut off at any edge, and nothing needs scrolling.
Visual style: light and calm, very high contrast. Page background #F4F4F2; white panels and cards with 16px corner radius and a 1px hairline #E3E3E3; near-black text #1A1A1A; secondary gray text #5D5D5D. Brand orange #FE4E10 is used only for the active menu item and for solid primary buttons (white bold text). Status colors are always paired with a text label: red #B42318 (미수, 지연, 미반납), amber #B45309 (일부, 대기), green #247A3D (완료), blue #0074D9 (차량 보관), purple #5F33E1 (리프트권). Korean sans-serif typeface similar to Pretendard; simple 2px line icons similar to Lucide.
Sizes for older staff: smallest text 16px, body 18px, names and section titles 22px bold, key numbers 32–40px bold, every touch target at least 52px tall, primary buttons 56px, 16px spacing between elements. Never use an ellipsis or clipped text: every label is fully visible; wrap to a second line instead of shrinking.
All UI text is Korean and must be rendered crisp, legible and spelled EXACTLY as written below. No lorem ipsum, no English UI labels, no watermark, no extra screens, no annotations, no callouts.
Common frame: a fixed left navigation rail 112px wide, white with a hairline on its right edge, holding nine stacked menu buttons 56px tall with 4px gaps; each button shows a 26px line icon above a 16px bold label, in this order from the top: 오늘 할 일, 1 접수·예약, 2 준비·지급, 3 이용·변경, 4 반납·회수, 5 정산·마감, 리프트권, 차량 운행, and 관리 pinned at the very bottom of the rail. The active menu is a solid orange rounded rectangle with white icon and white text; the others are dark gray on white. Top header bar 60px, white with a bottom hairline: on the left a small purple 16px bold wordmark 스키노트, then the gray 18px store name 우리 스키샵, then the bold 24px screen title, then a small pill; on the right a white outlined bell button with a red badge 1 and a white outlined button 나가기 with a door icon. Bottom footer bar 72px, white with a top hairline: on the left an 18px dark-gray summary sentence, on the right white outlined buttons and, when the screen has one, a solid orange primary button, all 56px tall with 18px bold labels.
Screen: 오늘 할 일 (the home screen). The active rail item is 오늘 할 일. Header title 오늘 할 일, followed by a light-orange pill with dark-orange 18px bold text "처리 대기 6가지" and gray 18px text "9월 17일 (수)".
Directly under the header, a white strip 64px tall with a bottom hairline: bold 18px label "지금 처리", then a solid orange button 52px tall with white 20px bold text "지급 · 박준호 팀", then gray 18px text "16:40 수령 · 설천 주차장"; at the right end a white outlined button "최신 기록 확인".
Content area: six large white tiles in 3 columns × 2 rows with 12px gaps that fill the content area completely (about 275×160 px each; nothing below them, no scrolling). Each tile is tappable: 22px bold title at the top left, a small status badge at the top right, then a 16px gray label with a 40px bold number under it, on the right side a 16px gray "기한" with the deadline in 20px bold under it, then one or two 18px lines of detail, and at the bottom right an orange 18px bold text "열기 ›". Tiles that need attention have a 2px red border and their badge sits as a small red legend on the top border line.
Tile 1: title "1 접수·예약", gray badge "접수 2팀", label "오늘 수령", number "2팀", 기한 "오늘 안", detail "박준호 팀 · 정하늘 팀", second detail in green "사이즈 입력 완료".
Tile 2 (red border): legend "미수 7팀", title "2 준비·지급", label "미지급", red number "8개", 기한 "16:40", detail in red "박준호 팀 · 정하늘 팀 지급 전".
Tile 3: title "3 이용·변경", blue badge "이용 중 3팀", label "요청", number "0건", 기한 "없음", detail "변경 요청 없음".
Tile 4 (red border): legend "미반납 있음", title "4 반납·회수", label "미반납", red number "13개", 기한 "16:30", detail "김민수 팀 · 김영희 팀 반납 예정", second detail in blue "차량 보관 2개".
Tile 5 (red border): legend "미수 7팀", title "5 정산·마감", label "정산 대기", red number "7건", 기한 "오늘 밤", detail in red "미수 970,000원".
Tile 6 (red border): legend "발권 필요", title "리프트권", label "발권 필요", red number "8매", 기한 "오늘 안", detail "김민수 팀 · 박준호 팀 발권 전", second detail in purple "보관 권 25매".
Footer: left summary "미지급 8개 · 미반납 13개 · 발권 8매 · 미수 970,000원 · 차량 업무 7건"; right: white outlined buttons "차량 운행" and "새 접수", then the solid orange primary button "마감".
Corrections after reviewing the first renders (fix these and keep everything else exactly as described above):
1. Spelling: in tile 4 the customer name is 김영희. Its third syllable is 희 (ㅎ with the vowel ㅢ), NOT 회. The line reads "김민수 팀 · 김영희 팀 반납 예정". Every 팀 ends with the consonant ㅁ, never ㄹ.
2. The small text came out too small, about 13–14px instead of 16px. Draw all small text noticeably larger: the nine rail labels (bold), the badges and red legends, the gray captions 오늘 수령 / 미지급 / 요청 / 미반납 / 정산 대기 / 발권 필요 / 기한, and the store name 우리 스키샵. A 16px label is about three quarters of the height of the 22px tile titles, and the 18px detail lines and the footer sentence are a little larger than that. When space is tight, shrink icons and padding, never the text.
3. The rail is 112px of the 1024px frame (about 11% of the canvas width), and all nine rail buttons, active or not, stack the icon ABOVE the label. A red legend sits on the top border line at the right end of its tile and never touches the tile title.
